===Transporting Ivan===
{{Needed|Combat equipment, including [[silver weaponry]] or [[Efaritay's aid]] to defeat 2 level 75 or 4 level 50 Vampyre Juvinates. Deposit any [[follower]]s you have into your bank as Ivan Strom will refuse to leave if you have one, even in your inventory.''|recommended=To give to Ivan Strom: [[Steel med helm]], [[Steel chainbody]], [[Steel platelegs]], [[Silver sickle]], 15 pieces of cooked [[food]] ([[snail]], [[salmon]], [[Cooked slimy eel|slimy eel]], or [[stew]])}}
{{Checklist|
*Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the hideout where the quest started. (The room under the Canifis pub)
*Talk to [[Polmafi Ferdygris]].
**'''Highly ''Recommended'''''<nowiki/>'': Give [[Ivan Strom]] some food (he only takes snail, salmon, slimy eel, or stew) and steel armour (he only takes a steel med helm, steel chainbody, and steel platelegs) before leaving.''
{{Instance}}
*Talk to Ivan Strom to go on a simplified version of [[Temple Trekking]] and take either the short or long route. (you can't bring a pet - it must be banked!)
**Route 1 features two level 75 [[Vampyre Juvinate]]s, whereas route 2 features 4 level 50 Juvinates.
*Kill the [[Vampyre Juvinates]] before they can kill Ivan Strom.
**''Tip:'' ''Alternate your attacks between them so they stay focused on you. Also, it may be possible to talk to Ivan to prevent the vampyre from attacking him''
*After you're done escorting Ivan, talk to [[Drezel]] in the underground temple for a key. {{Chat option|1Veliaf told me about Ivandis.|4Is there somewhere that I might get more information about Ivandis?|3The lives of those pitiful few left in Morytania could rest on this!}}
*Use the key on the [[keyhole (Paterdomus)|keyhole]] on the eastern wall and climb down the [[trapdoor (Paterdomus Library)|trapdoor]].
*Search the [[bookcase (Paterdomus Library)|bookcases]] in the hidden room until you find [[The sleeping seven]] (The title of the book at the top when reading it is "The Sleeping Seven"). Read it.
}}
